reviews.review:
A great conclusion to the trilogy and personally for me the best of the trilogy as well. I played the N7 Digital Deluxe Edition, which includes the Extended cut and all DLC so this is a reflection of my experience now and not some arbitrary hatred from the launch dates many many years ago.

The story is an emotional rollercoaster and does a great job at giving some closure to the storylines of many beloved characters of the series. Personally, I found the end extremely sattisfying and game will definitely hold a special place in my heart.

There are a few glitches here and there but none of them were game breaking. Visuals are a bit inconsistent with the ocassional very blurry texture, but you can install mods to fix that if you're so inclined or this bugs you. Story wise, I just can't recommend this enough. Just play it.
Imagine Witcher 3, but a little bit more linear and in space with less of the monster hunting. Great story.

**SPOILER ALERT** I have played this game "countless" times on both PC (Origin) and Xbox.. I navigated multiple playthroughs and I would still replay this game over any other RPG, besides Witcher 3 ;)  It's a hard comparison between the two and don't forget Dragon Age. However, no game has hit my emotions as much as this game.  In my humble opinion, the last conversation between Admiral Anderson and Commander Shepard is one of the biggest cinematic tear-jerkers in video game history. I've read all of the books and Anderson's back-story is almost more interesting than Shepard's; depending on what back-story that you choose for your character. I have replayed the entire game just to see what happens if I made different choices. If you like RPG/shooters, you WILL like this game. 10/10 hands down! PS, the Steam user reviews status should be overwhelmingly positive, but lots of folks seem to think that they are just rating EA's origin application. Come on... people

Been playing this game for 17.9 hours enjoying the ♥♥♥♥ out of it, until today when the ♥♥♥♥♥♥ won't launch anymore, I don't if its an issue with Origin or steam but either way pissed me off. So unless it fixes itself I'm going to go and play the entire trilogy again on my Xbox, but I can't be asked to replay them currently after I've been marathoning the trilogy. Gameplay is fluid and fun, Story is really good until the ending but I imagine most people know that already, DLC can be hit or miss, Leviathan was good, Omega not so much. Didn't get a chance to play Citadel because of the issue I have but from what I'v seen it's just Saints Row: 3 trouble with clones but in Mass Effect so goofy but still fun. I would recommend if you can actually play it.
